idea-plugin.name: Claude Session Browser
idea-plugin.description:
Browse, search and resume every Claude Code session from a tool window on the left. Sessions are grouped by project and show their title, age, model, message count and git branch.

  • Read before you resume — open a session's full conversation as a read-only transcript, then hit Continue session to pick it up in a new integrated Terminal tab (claude --resume <id>). The play button at the start of any row resumes it without opening the transcript.
  • Search — filter by title, project, git branch or tag instantly (the auto-derived ticket id included), or tick Content to search inside the messages themselves.
  • Organise — sessions tag themselves from their branch and title (the ticket id, plus topics like #bugfix or #migration); add your own by hand or ask Claude to suggest some. Rename, pin, export a transcript to Markdown, and delete single sessions or a multi-selection.
  • Multiple accounts — define an environment per Claude account and switch between them from the dropdown. Each carries its own session directory and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so resuming, tagging and MCP all act as that account.
  • Stats — a daily activity chart with week-on-week change, per-account usage (sessions, messages, tokens), your heaviest sessions, the files you keep returning to, which tools and MCP servers do the work, breakdowns by project, model, branch and tag, and how much of your history is searchable by Claude.
  • MCP — an optional local SQLite cache of every session, exposed to Claude Code so it can search your past work. One tick sets it up, indexes your history and schedules a daily refresh; searches stay scoped to the account you have selected.
  • Team sync — optionally share redacted session history with your team through a private git repository and pull theirs back, so Claude can answer "what did anyone on the team decide about X". Allowlisted projects only, a per-session Mark private that also retracts already-synced sessions, and a scheduled twice-daily cycle. A Health tab in Stats shows whether the background jobs, MCP registrations and tools are actually working.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Team sync: share redacted sessions with your team through a private git repo
  • Claude can search the whole team's history (scope: mine / team / one person)
  • Sync status strip: last run, what moved, and a live countdown to the next one
  • "Share with team" per session, ticked by default; unticking retracts it
  • Choose what Claude searches by default: your sessions or the team's
  • Skip trivial and old sessions; pause sharing; add your own redaction patterns
  • Get notified when a scheduled sync fails
  • Redesigned settings, health view and toolbar; project picker replaces typing names
  • MCP registration now covers every account, not just the active one
  • Tag suggestions no longer save CLI warnings as tags
  • One background job instead of two: the sync already re-indexes, so it no longer runs twice — and macOS lists a single item
  • Session search moved from the toolbar to Settings → General; Content now sits with the search field
  • Account and filter pickers redrawn as flat dropdowns instead of native combo boxes
  • Settings fields carry a worked example, and each switch says what it does
